name: Spherical Gaussian Visibility Approximation
definition: An approximation method to compute the integral of visibility multiplied by an SG lobe by preserving the center and scaling the amplitude, yielding another SG.
summary: Spherical Gaussian Visibility Approximation is a real-time technique that approximates visibility integrals using SG basis functions to preserve lobe centers and handle narrow specular lobes, unlike spherical harmonics.
